story.title: Login Screen
story.description:
As a registered user, log in with email and password to access the account.

Background: The user is on the login page.

Scenario: Successful login with valid credentials
Expected result: Authenticated and redirected to the dashboard / home page

Scenario: Empty email field
Expected result: Login button stays disabled or inactive

Scenario: Empty password field
Expected result: Login button stays disabled or inactive

Scenario: Invalid email format (example user@domain)
Expected result: Inline validation error; user stays on the login page

Scenario: Unregistered email, or valid email with the wrong password
Expected result: Invalid-credentials error; user stays on the page; password field is cleared

Scenario: Show / Hide on the password field
Expected result: Plain text, then masked again

Scenario: Forgot Password?
Expected result: Redirect to the password recovery page

Scenario: Either required field empty
Expected result: Login button stays disabled or inactive
notes: AC-2, AC-3, and AC-8 say Login stays disabled or inactive when a required field is empty, while tests 121217, 121218, and 121219 expect clicking Login to show validation errors. Preserve this contradiction as a story note; do not infer any test-to-criterion links.

tests.title: [AUTH-102065-P01] Verify successful login with valid registered email and correct password

[AUTH-102065-P05] Verify validation error for incorrectly formatted email
[AUTH-102065-P06] Verify error message for unregistered email
[AUTH-102065-P07] Verify error message and field reset for incorrect password

[AUTH-102065-P09] Verify 'Show' toggle reveals the entered password
[AUTH-102065-P11] Verify 'Login' button remains disabled when required fields are empty
[AUTH-102065-P12] Verify 'Login' button becomes active once valid inputs are entered
[AUTH-102065-P13] Verify navigation to the Forgot Password flow
